source_caption: Due Date is a comedy starring Robert Downey Jr. and Zach Galifianakis. It follows a high-strung architect who is forced to travel cross-country with an awkward and unpredictable aspiring actor to make it home in time for his child’s birth. What starts as a simple trip turns into a chaotic and hilarious road journey filled with mishaps, arguments, and unexpected bonding.
